states: Built production frontend bundle served locally via pulse-worker-browser with deterministic fixture API/WebSocket payloads covering fresh, stale-node, stopped-stale, hybrid agent-stale/hypervisor-fresh, recovered, and stale vSphere workloads.

Desktop light mode (Chromium 1440x940) and narrow touch dark mode (WebKit 360x820): zero console errors, zero page errors, zero HTTP >= 400 responses, and zero horizontal overflow across all 12 captured states.

Stale Proxmox node group displays an amber Stale data badge without falsely marking guests as Node offline; running stale workload db-primary displays an amber indicator and Stale · 18m cue while preserving last-known CPU, memory, disk, and uptime readings; stopped stale container cache-standby keeps its stopped indicator with Stale · 18m; hybrid VM web-hybrid with stale optional agent and fresh Proxmox source stays healthy.

Running filter excludes stale workloads (Running 2: api-fresh, web-hybrid) while Attention surfaces stale running workloads (Attention 1: db-primary); searching the provider timeout text matches stale workloads.

GuestDrawer header indicator matches the row warning dot and displays the amber Readings are stale inline notice with provider error and report age; live recovery clears node badge, row cues, filter counts, and drawer notice without reload.

vSphere overview routes stale VM app-db-01 to Attention 1 with amber dot and Stale · 22m cue while fresh app-web-01 stays Powered on 1. All comparable before and after captures were visually inspected.
interactions: Loaded /proxmox/overview with mixed fresh, stale, stopped-stale, and hybrid workloads; verified row cues and node group badge.
Toggled Running and Attention status filter buttons (opening the Filters disclosure on narrow phone viewport) and verified live filtered workload rows.
Entered provider error substring 'i/o timeout' into the workload search input and verified both stale workloads matched; cleared search.

Clicked stale workload db-primary to open GuestDrawer, verified warning header indicator and Readings are stale inline notice, then triggered live telemetry recovery refresh and verified reactive clearing.
Navigated to /vmware/overview and verified stale vs fresh vSphere VM indicators, Attention count, and Stale · 22m cue.
